pose: A detailed, close-up shot of a well-lit paleontological preparation laboratory bench, showcasing a delicate, hollow-boned pterosaur wing and skull fossil partially embedded in a multi-textured geological block. The block acts as a visual matrix puzzle, displaying distinct rock textures and colors from left to right. On the far left, the matrix features a fine, highly plastic, popcorn-textured layer of cream-colored bentonite clay, transitioning into bright, ultra-fine, powdery white chalk. The center section moves into dark, crumbly, charcoal-black patches of carbonaceous lignite, right next to smooth, dense, chocolate-brown mudstone. The right side shifts into grainy, rough-textured tan sandstone, highly fissile, layered grey shale that splits into thin sheets, and concludes with a porous, gritty, light-grey layer of volcanic tuff containing tiny mineral crystals. A preparator's hand is visible using a fine air-scribe and pin-tool, carefully clearing away dust to expose the dark, amber-colored petrified wing phalange. Bright task lighting catches the contrasting mineral grains and rocky textures for clear gameplay comparison.
